verdict.rationale: Jev's API returns structured Choice/Score/Noul answers rather than free-text generation, so there's no evidence of token-by-token streaming, and no first-party docs specify a latency SLA. The only latency signal is an anecdotal hands-on report of <400ms round-trip via OpenRouter (jev-comm-4), which is community evidence, not vendor-documented behavior. Missing for 10: official documentation of latency/response-time behavior, any streaming (SSE/token-by-token) API mode, and independent benchmark corroboration beyond one anecdotal comment.
